translations.web: Those who ate delicacies are desolate in the streets. Those who were brought up in purple embrace dunghills.
translations.bsb: Those who once ate delicacies are destitute in the streets; those brought up in crimson huddle in ash heaps.
translations.kjv: They that did feed delicately are desolate in the streets: they that were brought up in scarlet embrace dunghills.
translations.asv: They that did feed delicately are desolate in the streets: They that were brought up in scarlet embrace dunghills.
